title: Siena Scalp EEG Database: video-EEG monitoring of 14 adults with epilepsy (47 annotated seizures)
description: A BIDS curation of the Siena Scalp EEG Database, containing scalp video-EEG recordings from 14 adults with epilepsy (about 128 hours, 512 Hz, 10-20 electrode system, with EKG channels in most recordings). It includes 47 annotated seizures with clock-time onsets and ends, along with ILAE seizure type, localisation and lateralisation. The data were collected at the University of Siena during the PANACEE project on patient-specific seizure prediction. SzCORE seizure-detection annotations are provided as a derivative.
methods_description: Video-EEG was recorded at the Unit of Neurology and Neurophysiology, University of Siena, with EB Neuro and Natus Quantum LTM amplifiers and reusable silver/gold cup electrodes at 512 Hz. Patients stayed in bed, asleep or awake. Seizures were classified by an expert clinician according to ILAE criteria. The original EDF files are kept byte-identical, with channels, events and participants tables derived from the release text files.
